groups.title: Caches
groups.summary: Temporary downloads that apps rebuild automatically.

items.name: npm download cache
items.why: Copies of packages npm has already downloaded.
items.effect: The next npm install re-downloads only what it needs.
items.undo: Restore from Trash, or simply run npm install.

items.name: VS Code extension installers
items.why: Installer files for extensions that are already installed.
items.effect: None — VS Code downloads installers again only when it needs them.

items.name: Homebrew downloads
items.why: Old package downloads kept after installing.

groups.title: Leftovers from removed apps
groups.summary: Updaters and settings for apps that are no longer installed.

items.name: Microsoft Edge updater
items.why: Edge isn't installed, but its updater and downloaded updates were left behind.

items.name: Office shared data
items.warning: Office sometimes keeps autosaved documents here. Open the folder and rescue any .docx/.xlsx files first.

groups.title: Idle projects
